# Eval Results

> One row per run, newest at top. Rows are append-only. Each row links to the snapshot or notes file produced by that run.

## Suite

See [`docs/evals/agent-context-evals.md`](../../evals/agent-context-evals.md) for case definitions and metric definitions. Today, the runnable subset is FAC-001..005 from [`docs/superpowers/evals/first-agent-cases.json`](../../superpowers/evals/first-agent-cases.json).

---

## Process

- Each run appends one row to **History** and overwrites **Latest run** + **Case results**.
- A new pass/fail flip merits a paragraph in **Notes** explaining the change.
- Aggregate friction is recomputed each run; tags hitting the recurrence threshold are linked to roadmap items.
